The '''loading docks''' was a location on the [[planet]] [[Plazir-15]]. It was a commercial [[Spaceport|port]] on Plazir's [[ocean|seaside]] where ships docked and were unloaded of their cargo by a team of [[B2-series super battle droid]]s reprogrammed by [[lord]] [[Bombardier (individual)|Bombardier]]. They were commanded by a [[Unidentified B1-series battle droid foreman|B1-series droid foreman]] who personally oversaw their programming and performance.<ref name="Chapter 22">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 22: Guns for Hire}}</ref> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|22}}</ref> amidst a surge of [[droid]] malfunctions in the city, Bombardier and [[the Duchess]] tasked [[Mandalorian]] visitors [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] and [[Din Djarin]] with investigating the issues. Their investigation led them to the docks as the city's [[Ugnaught]] workers estimated the next malfunction to occur there, contrary to the foreman's claims that they had personally overseen their certification. Djarin began kicking the B2 workers as they filed in a line to load crates on a ship, triggering the [[Unidentified rogue B2-series battle droid|malfunctioning B2]] who shoved him and ran away, trying to escape.<ref name="Chapter 22" />
